messages.subject: Deducer & Out of memory error
parts:
Hi,

I try to get acquainted with Deducer but I can't get it run :
package ‘JGR’ get successfully unpacked

then:

> local({pkg <- select.list(sort(.packages(all.available = TRUE)),graphics=TRUE)
+ if(nchar(pkg)) library(pkg, character.only=TRUE)})
Loading required package: rJava
Loading required package: JavaGD
Loading required package: iplots
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'iplots', details:
  call: .jnew("org/rosuda/iplots/Framework")
  error: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: unable to create new native thread
Error: package ‘iplots’ could not be loaded

How can I attack this out of memory error in windows XP professional ?

TIA
Frank

parts:

messages.subject: How to add color option to plots
parts:
Hi all,

What is the bet way to add the Geom color by option e.g. colour = Species
in plots so each point is colored different to match the Species variable?

When using GGplot this is added like this example below:

ggplot(ElSal, aes(Date, elapsed, colour = Location)) +
ï¿½ geom_jitter() +
ï¿½ facet_wrap(~ Species)
#adding the ylab line works.
breaks <- (1:24) * 3600
labels <- paste(c(19:23, 0:18), "00", sep = ":")
f=png(file=" El Salonl_plot.png", width = 1000, height = 600,
ï¿½ï¿½ï¿½ï¿½ units = "px", pointsize = 8, bg = "white",
ï¿½ï¿½ï¿½ï¿½ res = NA, restoreConsole = TRUE)

I vaguely recall there is a way in Deducer to display the actual code in the console where I could copy the plot lines and add the geom parameterï¿½ color= whatever


Tnx
Bruce

4/ start JGR by double clicking the jgr.exe

at stats-ros...@listserv.uni-augsburg.de


best,
